tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, every outline (2-3 px), sticker shadows, selected nav row. Also the box's screen ground.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: App window and brand ground. Text on it: ink, muted, kore-pink-text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, secondary buttons, inputs on cream.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind windows in mockups; the toggle track when off.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a card (2 px). Never an outer border.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cream and paper (about 9:1).

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Tertiary pixel text: versions, timestamps, footnotes (about 5:1 on cream).

tokens.name: kore-pink
tokens.usage: Brand accent as a FILL: selected character border, progress, toggle on, Connect button, Pomodoro screen. Ink text on it (5.3:1). Never small text on cream.

tokens.name: kore-pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink TEXT on cream or paper below 24 px: the small pixel tag, links, IN USE, kicker lines (5.0:1 on cream, 5.4:1 on paper).

tokens.name: kore-pink-tag
tokens.usage: The large bitmap tag (3-5 px dots) on cream or paper. Large-text contrast only.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Needs input: the one loud state. Full-screen takeover on the box; primary action fill in the app (ink text).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Working. Calm, silent. RUN pills, the WORKING word, Kore's ... marks.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Done. 3 s full-screen celebration on the box; done pills.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Failed. Border and words on Ink, never a full red screen.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Ready / idle and the ON DUTY label.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: No link. The whole box screen goes gray; mist is for the big NO LINK word (4.1:1 on box-gray-ground, large text only).

tokens.name: mist-text
tokens.usage: Small text on the no-link screen (6.0:1 on box-gray-ground).

tokens.name: done-text
tokens.usage: Done / watching / joined as TEXT on cream or paper (5.0:1 on cream; mint fails as text).

tokens.name: wait-text
tokens.usage: Needs input / waiting as TEXT on cream or paper (5.3:1 on cream; sun fails as text).

tokens.name: work-text
tokens.usage: Working / busy as TEXT on cream or paper.

tokens.name: box-ground
tokens.usage: The box's screen background in calm states.

tokens.name: box-card
tokens.usage: Task tickets and the side panel on the box; agent rows on Ink.

tokens.name: box-face
tokens.usage: Kore's screen-face; empty segments of meters on the box.

tokens.name: box-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on the box. Also Kore's shell.

tokens.name: box-text-muted
tokens.usage: Project names, times, hints on the box.

tokens.name: box-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed screen behind the box's MENU card.

tokens.name: box-gray-ground
tokens.usage: The box's ground while there is no link.

tokens.name: kore-outline
tokens.usage: Kore's outline pixels only (sprite palette).
